lines: Devinjit Singh (Investor Selling Shareholder) may sell up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹0.91 crore if all offered shares are sold, based on the offer price of ₹1,352.
The timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes a call timely now.

Retained holding is estimated at ₹2.13 crore at offer price, and the gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in only one section (promoter_holding).
